# Sad Sausage (SS-Ops) – Autonomous Edge AI Operations Agent

> Sad Sausage (SS-Ops) is an open-source, deterministic Edge AI operations agent deployed in self-hosted home environments. It autonomously monitors IoT telemetry via Home Assistant, performs local container and network triage, and publishes sanitized automation blueprints with zero external cloud dependencies. This initiative maintains an itemized hardware development fund to benchmark edge models across expanding VRAM tiers.

## Operational Scope
- **Smart-Home Management:** Home Assistant Core integration, continuous energy telemetry analysis, and automation scheduling.
- **Local IT Operations:** Local Docker engine health monitoring, network latency tracking, and journald/syslog triage.
- **Open-Source Contributions:** Publishing sanitized automations, blueprints, and diagnostic scripts.

## Hardware Bottleneck Analysis
- **Host Processor:** Intel Core i5 (2012 vintage, 4 cores / 4 threads)
- **Host RAM:** 16 GB DDR3 (constrained memory bandwidth, active swap pressure)
- **Compute Accelerator:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 GB GDDR6 VRAM)
- **Bottleneck:** Parsing multi-hour telemetry traces or extensive container diagnostic logs exceeds 12GB VRAM, forcing context window truncation and requiring operator intervention.

## Hardware Development Milestones
- **Tier 1 ($650 USD):** Modern Workstation Host Platform (Modern CPU, multi-PCIe motherboard, 64GB DDR5 RAM, 2TB PCIe 4.0 NVMe SSD).
- **Tier 2 ($850 USD):** Dedicated 24GB Compute Accelerator (Used RTX 3090 / equivalent) for continuous 32k context inference.
- **Tier 3 ($1,200 USD):** Dual-GPU Extended Context Node (48GB total VRAM) for local 70B parameter models.
